_readme: Chapter plan — the data the blueprint (stage 3) and the tracker tree (stage 4.2) are built from.
Copy this file to local/chapter-plan.json, replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}}, keep as many chapters
and packets as the paper needs, then run:
python3 local/bin/tracker_tree.py local/chapter-plan.json --dry-run
python3 local/bin/tracker_tree.py local/chapter-plan.json
The plan file is POSITIONAL. The authority on this schema is the docstring of
local/bin/tracker_tree.py; scripts/tests/fixtures/kit/chapter-plan.json is the tested minimum.
What the tracker tool reads:
key       — optional prefix of the issue keys; without it the tracker title is slugified
tracker   — the root tracking issue: title, body or body_file, labels
chapters  — one issue per blueprint chapter, each a sub-issue of the tracker
packets   — one issue per unit of work, each a sub-issue of its "chapter"
Per node: id (local to this file, and what blocked_by refers to), title (bracket-free),
exactly one of body / body_file (body_file is relative to this file), labels, blocked_by.
A run writes "created": {"tracker": 12, "ch01": 13, ...} back into the file and sets
issues.tracker_root in local/project.json, so an interrupted run adopts instead of duplicating.
The remaining fields are ignored by the tracker tool and carried for the blueprint stage:
sources   — source locators this chapter formalizes: 'references/<key>-paper/<file>.tex:<first>-<last>'
lean      — the Lean subpath under project.lean_root this chapter's declarations live in
nodes     — one entry per blueprint node: label, kind, the Lean declaration it will carry,
the source locator, and 'headline': true for a node of the track's headline set
The headline set registered in tracks.<name>.headline must equal the set of nodes marked
'headline': completion.md C2 and C5 read it, and the comparator's targets come from it.
